profile.headline: Tech Lead
profile.summary: I have software, system architecture, design, and engineering experience within the health, defense, and private sectors and have served as CTO, principal software developer, architect, and technical lead on many projects.

positions.title: Senior Advisor
positions.description:
●​ Performed pen and performance testing and helped rearchitect the platform to alleviate findings.

●​ Created a container that generated K6 load testing scripts from OpenAPI specs, used hangfire for scheduled load testing, Grafana for result reporting and analysis, and a suite of restful endpoints for programmatic integration.

●​ Integrated Sentry into both the Angular front end and .Net middleware to better catch and remediate bugs.

●​ Provided .Net code for port-based integration with EPIC HL7 message passing and HL7 parsing best practices.

●​ Created Slack Bot application in ASP.Net with Restful APIs to coordinate message passing and channel management.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
• For fun I'm creating a web platform that can safely execute AI code, train models, chat with LLMs, and integrate with applications via REST APIs for inference. The best way to learn is to do!

• OpenAPI support with service discovery. Making it easy to integrate AL/ML functionality within client applications.

• Federated deployments with trust - sharing capabilities, training data, and cultivated models.

• Able to detect and use CUDA capable hardware for AI acceleration. CPU fallback when needed. ROCm in the future.

• Web-based rendering, editing, and execution of Jupyter notebooks, Python, Pytorch, and C# tensor based prep code.
positions.insights: Skills: onnx · REST · PyTorch · Docker Products · CUDA · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · .NET Core · Product Development · Machine Learning · React.js · gRPC · ASP.NET MVC · Microservices

positions.title: CTO / Head of Engineering
positions.description:
• Responsible for the management, direction, and technical oversight of the engineering team. 

• Implemented best practices from ticketing, coding, CI/CD, security, and up to sales literature using Atlassian products. 

• Experience with contracts, RFPs, customer onboarding and retention, SOC2, FIPS199, section 508,  HIPAA, PII, guiding HealthRx through NIH / FDA / & private industry contracts.

• Experience with occupational health and medicine within the NIH, FDA, University of Michigan, and other hospitals. I worked closely and in person with nurses, doctors, patients, and other stakeholders to help drive product deployment, adoption, and success.

• Led team to refactor monolithic platform to AWS Lambda and Docker containers via AWS ECS and created C# tools to provision resources for fast customer onboarding.

• Helped run the yearly NIH (12+ years) / FDA (4 years) / University of Michigan (5 years) flu immunization drives keeping track of vaccination lots & types, employee contraindications, and over 40,000 delivered flu immunizations per year.

• Responsible for the migration of all corporate assets to AWS when transitioning HealthRx to fully remote.

• Spearheaded web-based analytics application including SQL GUI query designer, role-based DB table access, and custom data feeds for use in client-facing KPI dashboards, Tableau, and summary docs.

• Led team to create a web-based C# dev platform for custom client business logic.

• Architect for security layer supporting role-based access, IP restrictions, browser restrictions, SAML 2.0 assertions, account login time frames, and machine fingerprinting.

• Pharmacogenomics project lead tieing human genome data, gene variants, and CPIC drug data to better understand drug regimen impacts on individuals. 

• Awarded “Patient Safety Champion Award” by the NIH Clinical Center Director, John I. Gallin, M.D. for our novel Apple iPad apps to process 20,000+ employees during the NIH's annual Flu Vaccination Program.
positions.insights: Skills: REST · Occupational Health · Amazon S3 · Immunization · FIPS · Azure DevOps Server · .NET Framework · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · .NET Core · Databases · Electronic Medical Record (EMR) · Product Development · Machine Learning · Occupational Medicine · HL7 Standards · SOC2 · Team Leadership · Amazon EC2 · FedRAMP · React.js · ASP.NET MVC · Microservices · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Principal engineer on ESM project including the implementation of the JESM specification for web service metrics collection over JUM, and periodic SLA verification using Quartz.

•	Lead engineer supporting the development and acceptance of the DDMS (Department of Defense Meta Data Specification) for use within the IC to markup document and resource metadata.

•	Lead engineer for HP/DIA contract to research, document, and deploy HP SOA Systinet suite of tools within the DIA to support UDDI based web service / resource publication and management.

•	Senior engineer on the EADS project developing JavaScript data visualization tools to display complex relationships of entities in a digestible manner to the user directly within the web browser.

•	Supported the development of Java object to relational DB mappings used by all parts of the EADS code base via Hibernate to speed development time.
positions.insights: Skills: REST · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Databases · Product Development · Natural Language Processing (NLP)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Note that ManTech acquired McDonald Bradley.

•	Supported the development and enhancement of the Automated Metadata Population Service (AMPS) to enhance the availability of discoverable metadata throughout the Air Force.

•	Implemented Open Office replacement using Apache POI for document text parsing. Cut AMPS overall document processing time in half, reduced app size by 400 Mb, reduced compile time from 10min to 1.5min, increased user throughput, and increased overall system stability. Finally designed and implemented Windows/Linux (64/32bit) AMPS deployment package for use by customer.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Product Development · Natural Language Processing (NLP)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• https://github.com/tgui9660/SimpleTune - Sole architect / engineer for custom automotive tuning platform.

• 3D visualization via OpenGL

• Reverse engineering of automotive ROMs using IDA Pro, specifically MAP based fueling
replacement for MAF based fueling.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	The specific tasks below were part of a large DoD / DNI effort to make available near real time data from any number of data sources / agencies in a central GUI for use by data analysts.

•	Technical lead for the push to integrate CIA WIRe and LNI into the ICDL framework. Designed, implemented, and deployed code that extracts historical and new DDMS records into the ICDL.

•	Designed and developed code base to enable the quick addition of data sources to our data aggregating framework.

•	Developed a GWT web app to control indexing and other state of data sources feeding our framework. Tool also reported important metrics on indexing progress and other important failures.

•	Implement code and logic needed to pull all historical data from any data source added to the ICDL framework. This is needed to populate indexing software to speed up data retrieval.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Acted as a component technical lead overseeing all work related to application integration and deployment.

•	Designed and developed a custom data migration utility for the Information Management System for Mine Action (IMSMA) project to replace a commercial tool that was found to be too limited in capabilities. 

•	Designed and developed app to tie together the functionality and deployment of the IMSMA client and server applications. 

•	Implemented a large subset of the IMSMA client-side application. Worked to provide detailed documentation on GUI functionality and design.

•	Worked as a developer on the Web Service visualization team. Researched and deployed JUDDI web service server and created proof-of-concept tool to publish WSRP WSDLs to said UDDI server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote Java package to convert between approximately 100 units of measure commonly used within the oil industry. 

•	Wrote Java (POI / HSSF) utilities to parse data from Excel spreadsheets to streamline the migration of data stored within Excel files to Oracle databases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1/2 time 20hr/week Software Engineering.

•	Designed, built, and deployed problem tracking system based on Perl and CGI. Nominated for award recognizing my efforts on this project. (Global Stars).

•	Provided code framework for department’s new website design.
